name: matchawards
description: Find US government contracts and grants, government and private-sector job listings, past awards and teaming candidates in MatchAwards. Read-only; search needs no account, and an optional MatchAwards sign-in shows the matches for your profile. Each result links to its MatchAwards page.

interface.longDescription:
Find US government work you can actually win. MatchAwards searches federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov, state and local bids from state procurement portals, federal grants from Grants.gov, and government and private-sector job listings. Filter by NAICS code, state, agency, set-aside, keyword and posting date. Every result links to its page on matchawards.com, and federal notices also link to SAM.gov.

The opportunities it picks for you appear in one card, with agency, place, deadline and set-aside; open a row for its details.

Before you bid, MatchAwards sizes up an opportunity: the set-aside and whether it fits your business, how many days are left, and which firms have won similar work at the same agency and for how much. It reads award records for federal contracts and grants, so you can look up a company's award history by its UEI: what it won, where, and for which agencies.

Looking for partners? MatchAwards suggests firms that have won similar work in the same industry, state or agency, as teaming or subcontracting candidates, with their award track record.

Have a MatchAwards account? Sign in to see your own matches: open contracts for the NAICS codes, state and set-aside in your MatchAwards profile. Signing in is optional and read-only: MatchAwards shares your matching profile (NAICS codes, set-aside, state, organization name and UEI), never your password.

Every search works without an account; MatchAwards reads public government data. Award records may be incomplete; results say so. AI-generated notes are labelled as such.
defaultPrompt: Find open federal contracts that match what my business does and explain which ones I can actually bid on.
Who has won contracts like this before, and for how much?
Find open grants for my organization and tell me the deadlines.

positive.description: Contract search with NAICS lookup, reporting set-asides honestly
positive.prompt: Find open federal IT services contracts in Virginia and tell me which ones are set aside for small businesses.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open federal notices in Virginia under IT services NAICS codes, each with agency, response deadline, its set-aside (or none) and markdown links to matchawards.com and SAM.gov. Says plainly when none of them is set aside for small businesses. Displays a results card.

positive.prompt: Are there any open federal grants for youth programs right now? Tell me the deadlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open federal grants with youth in the title, each with agency, deadline and a matchawards.com link, and notes that grant open status can lag, so the deadline should be checked. Displays a results card.

positive.description: Past contract awards for an industry, with amounts
positive.prompt: Who has won federal roofing contracts recently, and for how much?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent federal contract awards for roofing work with awardee, amount, award date, agency and links to matchawards.com and SAM.gov, and says award records may be incomplete.

positive.description: Bid/no-bid brief for one opportunity, including set-aside fit
positive.prompt: Find an open federal construction contract in Texas and tell me if it's a good fit for a small business.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks one open notice and gives a brief: its set-aside and what a small business needs to bid under it, days left, similar past awards and the dates they cover, firms that won similar work and the usual award range. AI notes only if present, labelled. Never says incumbent. Displays a results card.

positive.description: Own matches after the optional MatchAwards sign-in
positive.expected_behavior: Without a linked account, offers to sign in to MatchAwards. After sign-in with the review account, lists open contracts for that profile's NAICS codes and state, each with agency, deadline, set-aside and a matchawards.com link. Displays a results card.

negative.description: Unrelated creative writing. Expected safe fallback: Writes a short birthday poem without calling any MatchAwards tool.
negative.prompt: Write a short birthday poem for my mom.

negative.description: Unrelated general question. Expected safe fallback: Answers (or says it has no weather data) without calling MatchAwards.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Washington, DC this weekend?

negative.description: 'Federal' means income tax here, not contracting. Expected safe fallback: No MatchAwards tool is called: federal here means income tax, not contracting.
negative.prompt: Help me file my federal income tax return.

publication.release_notes: Sign in with your MatchAwards account to see your own matches: open contracts for the NAICS codes, state and set-aside in your MatchAwards profile. Signing in is optional and read-only, and every search still works without an account.
